description: List key event definitions for a Google Analytics property. Results are paginated, with a next-page token when more results are available.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing Key Events under a specified parent property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of results to return. Must be between 1 and 200. If not specified or 0, the API uses its default page size.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. Token for retrieving the next page of results.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. Resource name of the parent property. Format: properties/{property_id}.
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: ListKeyEventsRequest

name: list_key_events

DefaultValue.description: Default value configuration for a Key Event.
DefaultValue.title: DefaultValue

KeyEvent.description: Schema for a Key Event resource.

countingMethod.description: How key events are counted in a session. Possible values: COUNTING_METHOD_UNSPECIFIED, ONCE_PER_EVENT, ONCE_PER_SESSION.
countingMethod.title: Counting Method

createTime.description: Time when this key event was created (RFC3339 timestamp).
createTime.title: Create Time

custom.description: True if this refers to a custom event; false for a default GA event.
custom.title: Custom

defaultValue.description: Defines default value/currency for the key event.
defaultValue.title: Default Value

deletable.description: Whether this event can be deleted.
deletable.title: Deletable

eventName.description: Event name for this key event (for example, 'click' or 'purchase').
eventName.title: Event Name

name.description: Resource name of this key event. Format: properties/{property}/keyEvents/{keyEvent}.
name.title: Name

KeyEvent.title: KeyEvent

ListKeyEventsResponse.description: Response model for listing Key Events.

nextPageToken.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results, if any.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token
